Maya Chen: Quick a11y sweep of the Projects list view — spotted 3 things: status chips low contrast, focus ring lost when cards wrap, and toasts aren't announced by screen readers. attaching short clips and repro steps. Liam O'Neill: Nice catch. Can you paste contrast numbers + repro steps? Maya Chen: Contrast: green chip #00b37e on #ffffff for small label ~2.8:1 (fails). Need >=4.5:1 for small text. Repro: mac VoiceOver (Safari), NVDA (Chrome) on Windows. Steps: tab into Projects, use keyboard to move across cards; when layout wraps to 2 cols the visible focus outline is clipped or disappears. Also toasts (save success) don't get announced. Samira Patel: Sounds like `overflow:hidden` on the container might be clipping the outline we added. We added that to keep shadows from overflowing. Quick fix options: outline-offset, or flip to box-shadow on focus, or set `overflow:visible` on focus. Samira Patel: Example: ```css .project-card:focus { outline: 3px solid #005fa3; outline-offset: 2px; } .project-card:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,95,163,0.15); } ``` Jonas Rivera: For the chips, let's pick a darker token so we don't rely on bolding. Suggestion: #006b3f for active green, and add `aria-label=\"Status: Active\"` or visually hidden text for screen readers. :eyes: A11yBot: Automated contrast check failed for 3 elements on /console/projects. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/a11y/1851249876 Maya Chen: For toasts: current markup uses `role=\"status\"` but the container wasn't a live region. Recommend adding `aria-live=\"polite\" aria-atomic=\"true\"` on the toast rail. Also ensure toasts aren't inside an `aria-hidden` subtree. Example: `
` Liam O'Neill: Agree on aria-live polite for success and maybe assertive for errors. Also the focus order problem could be solved with a roving tabindex pattern for the card grid so arrow keys move within the grid and Tab exits. Avoids the tab trap. Samira Patel: Roving tabindex 👍 — keep DOM order the same for screen readers (move focus, not DOM). We'll need to add keyboard handlers for ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down and Home/End. Jonas Rivera: I'll draft a small PR: increase chip contrast, add aria-labels/visually-hidden text for status, add live region for toasts, and update focus styles + overflow fix. ETA: EOD tomorrow. Maya Chen: Test plan before merging: 1) automated a11y suite, 2) keyboard-only walkthrough of project list + open project modal, 3) VoiceOver on mac + NVDA on Windows, 4) colorblindness simulator check. Ping me when PR ready. :thumbsup: Liam O'Neill: Created Jira ticket INV-3219 and linked design doc: https://confluence/internal/design/projects-a11y A11yBot: Reminder scheduled — accessibility review sync tomorrow 10:30am PT. :calendar:
